SHAREHOLDERS_AGREEMENT.title: Board and Reserved Matters (Investor-Protective)
SHAREHOLDERS_AGREEMENT.rendered_text: The governance of the Company shall reflect the protective rights agreed in favour of the Investor(s), and the board composition shall be A board of five directors: two nominated by the promoters, one by the incoming subscriber, and two independent directors appointed by mutual agreement. (a) The Board of Directors shall comprise such number of Directors as agreed; each Investor holding not less than the agreed threshold shall be entitled to nominate at least one Investor Director, and the quorum for any Board meeting shall require the presence of at least one Investor Director (subject to adjournment provisions where an Investor Director is absent from successive meetings). (b) Notwithstanding any other provision, none of the matters listed as Reserved Matters (including Altering the share capital, approving a budget above the agreed threshold, incurring borrowing above Rs. 1,00,00,000, and any related party transaction. , and any change to the charter documents, share capital, business plan, related-party transactions, incurrence of indebtedness above agreed thresholds, winding up, or any merger, acquisition, or disposal of material assets) shall be undertaken by the Company or its Board without the prior written affirmative consent of the Investor(s) or the Investor Director(s). (c) The Investor(s) shall have customary information and inspection rights, including audited and management accounts, and access to the books and records of the Company. (d) These rights are intended to operate within the framework of the Companies Act, 2013, and shall, to the extent required, be incorporated into the Articles of Association of the Company; in the event of any conflict between this Agreement and the Articles as between the Shareholders, this Agreement shall prevail and the Shareholders shall procure amendment of the Articles accordingly.

findings.evidence: this Agreement shall prevail and the Shareholders shall procure amendment of the Articles

variables.drafting_for: Which side are you on?: the arrangement agreed between the parties in writing before performance begins, recorded here in full and not by reference to any other document.
variables.advocate_enrolment_number: Advocate's Enrolment Number: the arrangement agreed between the parties in writing before performance begins, recorded here in full and not by reference to any other document.
variables.notice_facts:
1. By an agreement dated 12 March 2026 my client agreed to supply goods to you on thirty days' credit.
2. My client delivered the goods on 5 May 2026 and raised invoice 44/2026 for Rs. 4,50,000 on the same day.
3. You acknowledged receipt of the goods in writing on 6 May 2026 and raised no complaint.
4. The invoice fell due on 4 June 2026 and remains wholly unpaid.
variables.breached_obligation: clause 6 of the agreement dated 12 March 2026, which requires payment within thirty days of a valid tax invoice
variables.loss_description: the loss of the use of Rs. 4,50,000 since 4 June 2026, and the cost of financing the shortfall in working capital
variables.notice_demand: pay my client Rs. 4,50,000 towards invoice 44/2026, together with interest at 12 per cent per annum from 4 June 2026 to the date of payment
variables.underlying_liability: the price of stainless steel kitchen equipment supplied under invoice 44/2026 dated 5 May 2026
variables.admitted_facts: That an agreement dated 12 March 2026 was entered into between the parties, and that two consignments were delivered under it.
variables.denied_facts: That any consignment was defective, that any complaint was made within the contractual window, and that any sum remains due.
variables.reply_facts: The goods were inspected on delivery and accepted without protest. The first complaint was made four months later, after the contractual inspection window had closed, and only once payment fell due.
variables.counter_claim_description: Your Counter-Claim: the arrangement agreed between the parties in writing before performance begins, recorded here in full and not by reference to any other document.
variables.counter_demand: What You Want From Them: the arrangement agreed between the parties in writing before performance begins, recorded here in full and not by reference to any other document.
variables.underlying_agreement_description: the Supply Agreement for stainless steel kitchen equipment
variables.disputes_description: whether the consignment delivered on 5 May 2026 conformed to the agreed specification, whether the sum of Rs. 4,50,000 is due, and whether the agreement was validly terminated on 20 July 2026.
variables.claims_description: Rs. 4,50,000 as the price of goods sold and delivered, interest at 12 per cent per annum from 4 June 2026, and the costs of the arbitration.
variables.dispute_description: the quality of goods supplied under invoice 44/2026 and the sum said to be due for them
variables.proceedings_description: Commercial Suit 214 of 2026, pending before the Commercial Court at Pune
variables.settlement_payment_schedule: in three equal monthly instalments, the first falling due thirty days after this Agreement
variables.affidavit_purpose: filing before the Registrar of Companies in support of an application for the change of registered office
variables.verification_place: Place of Swearing: the arrangement agreed between the parties in writing before performance begins, recorded here in full and not by reference to any other document.
variables.obligor_description: a company incorporated under the Companies Act, 2013 and having its registered office at the address below
variables.beneficiary_description: a company incorporated under the Companies Act, 2013 and having its registered office at the address below
variables.bond_occasion: The Beneficiary has been asked to release consignment 44/2026 from its warehouse without production of the original delivery order, the original having been lost in transit.
variables.indemnified_risk: the release of consignment 44/2026 without production of the original delivery order, including any claim brought by a person presenting that original at a later date
variables.board_structure: A board of five directors: two nominated by the promoters, one by the incoming subscriber, and two independent directors appointed by mutual agreement.
variables.reserved_matters: Altering the share capital, approving a budget above the agreed threshold, incurring borrowing above Rs. 1,00,00,000, and any related party transaction.
variables.founder_roles: The first Founder is responsible for product and engineering; the second Founder is responsible for sales, finance and compliance.
variables.founder_equity_split: Sixty per cent to the first Founder and forty per cent to the second Founder, in each case vesting monthly over four years with a twelve-month cliff.
variables.vesting_cliff: Twelve months from the grant date
variables.exercise_window: Ninety days from the date of vesting, or until the date the option lapses under the Scheme, whichever is earlier.
variables.securities_subscribed: 1,00,000 Compulsorily Convertible Preference Shares of face value Rs. 10 each, issued at a premium of Rs. 490 each, converting to equity on a one-for-one basis.
variables.use_of_proceeds: Hiring engineering and sales staff, funding a twelve-month marketing programme, and meeting working capital requirements.
variables.repayment_terms: list price less a 15 percent trade discount, invoiced monthly and payable within 30 days of a valid tax invoice
variables.assigned_work_description: The source code, database schema, user interface designs and technical documentation of the inventory management application developed by the Assignor between January and July 2026.
variables.powers_granted: To operate the principal's bank account numbered 001234567890 at the Pune branch, to sign cheques on it up to Rs. 5,00,000, and to file and receive documents from the Registrar of Companies.
variables.goods_or_services_description: Subscription access to a cloud-hosted inventory management platform, with onboarding, data migration and email support.
variables.learning_objectives: Exposure to production software development practices, code review, testing and release management, under the supervision of a named mentor.
variables.party_1_authority_reference: Board resolution dated 12 August 2026, a certified copy of which is annexed to this Agreement.
variables.party_2_authority_reference: Board resolution dated 14 August 2026, a certified copy of which is annexed to this Agreement.
variables.liability_cap_basis: Fees paid or payable in the 12 months before the claim
variables.audit_rights: Compliance may be audited once in any twelve-month period, on fifteen days' written notice, during business hours and at the auditing party's own cost.
variables.information_rights: Monthly management accounts within twenty-one days of month end, audited accounts within ninety days of the financial year end, and an annual budget before the year begins.
variables.additional_protection_clauses: A twelve-month non-solicitation of the disclosing party's employees and a prohibition on reverse engineering any disclosed prototype.
variables.voting_rights: One vote per equity share on a poll; the preference shares carry votes only on matters directly affecting their rights.
variables.dividend_policy: No dividend is to be declared for the first three financial years; thereafter the board may recommend a dividend of up to thirty per cent of distributable profits.
variables.tag_along_rights: If a promoter transfers shares to a third party, the remaining holders may require that purchaser to buy their shares on the same terms and in the same proportion.
variables.exit_rights: A listing or trade sale may be required after five years, with a tag-along right on any transfer by the promoters.
